item.title: How to create a promise in JavaScript
item.description: Creating custom promises enables you to wrap asynchronous operations like timers, callbacks, and legacy APIs in modern promise-based workflows. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built numerous custom promises for complex asynchronous operations. From my expertise, the most effective approach is using the Promise constructor with resolve and reject functions to control the promise state. This pattern allows seamless integration of any asynchronous operation into promise chains.
